parsed.why: Adds its own tier-1 layer over the hostile parent: criminalizing bathroom use in government buildings AND private businesses, up to a year jailed, in force July 2026, plus birth-certificate ban and parental-disclosure law. Only pending litigation as remedy.

Protective operating regime documented working: broad anti-discrimination, protected facilities, X markers, hate-crime coverage, court ordering care resumed, refuge protections. Parent's passport/entry regime still applies to every visitor, capping the score; pending ballot measures and funding pressure trim it.

Hostile division over hostile parent: ranked worst for anti-trans legislation, birth-certificate changes banned forcing document disclosure, state-facility bathroom restrictions, parental-disclosure rules, no state discrimination law, hate-crime law excludes gender identity. Offset only by two-spirit traditions and majority public support.

Documented protective machinery: trans-youth sanctuary law, identity-based prison housing, top-tier protective-law band. But highest raw anti-LGBTQ incident count nationally, rising city hate-crime reports, governor platforming anti-trans figures; parent's document and entry regime unchanged.

Broad anti-discrimination survived repeat referenda, hate-crime enhancement, panic defence abolished, X markers on licences and birth certificates, no facility restrictions, court-confirmed bathroom access, low-risk assessment. Parent's national document/entry regime and university sports capitulation hold it below 0.70.
